edition.witness_note: Lake 1912 Loeb copy-text; Lightfoot/Funk middle recension not yet locked as second witness

source_text: [1] Καὶ ὑμῖν δὲ πρέπει μὴ συγχρᾶσθαι τῇ ἡλικίᾳ τοῦ ἐπισκόπου, ἀλλὰ κατὰ δύναμιν θεοῦ πατρὸς πᾶσαν ἐντροπὴν αὐτῷ ἀπονέμειν, καθὼς ἔγνων καὶ τοὺς ἁγίους πρεσβυτέρους οὐ προσειληφότας τὴν φαινομένην νεωτερικὴν τάξιν, ἀλλ’ ὡς φρονίμους ἐν θεῷ συγχωροῦντας αὐτῷ, οὐκ αὐτῷ δέ, ἀλλὰ τῷ πατρὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, τῷ πάντων ἐπισκόπῳ. [2] εἰς τιμὴν οὖν ἐκείνου τοῦ θελήσαντος ἡμᾶς πρέπον ἐστὶν ἐπακούειν κατὰ μηδεμίαν ὑπόκρισιν: ἐπεὶ οὐχ ὅτι τὸν ἐπίσκοπον τοῦτον τὸν βλεπόμενον πλανᾷ τις, ἀλλὰ τὸν ἀόρατον παραλογίζεται. τὸ δὲ τοιοῦτον οὐ πρὸς σάρκα ὁ λόγος, ἀλλὰ πρὸς θεὸν τὸν τὰ κρύφια εἰδότα.
pass_a_gloss: And it is fitting for you too not to take advantage of the bishop's youth, but to give him all respect according to the power of God the Father, just as I know that the holy presbyters too have not taken advantage of his apparently youthful rank, but, as men wise in God, they yield to him; yet not to him, but to the Father of Jesus Christ, the bishop of all. So, for the honor of him who desired us, it is fitting to obey without any hypocrisy, since it is not that a person deceives this bishop who is seen, but he cheats the one who is unseen. In such a case the reckoning is not with flesh but with God, who knows the hidden things.

lemmas.gloss: make use of, take advantage of

pass_b_english: You too must not presume on your bishop's youth. Give him every mark of respect, as befits the power of God the Father. I know your holy presbyters have done just that. They have not exploited his young standing, as it looks to the eye. They are wise in God, and they defer to him. Or rather, not to him, but to the Father of Jesus Christ, the Bishop of all.

So, to honor the One who has desired us, obey without pretense. Whoever plays false here does not fool this bishop whom he can see; he tries to cheat the Bishop he cannot see. In such a case his account is not with a man of flesh but with God, who knows what is hidden.

choices.why: The verb means to treat something as usable for oneself; the fault is exploiting, not merely noticing, his age.
Title of the Father; capitalized as a divine title, and it sets up the seen/unseen bishop contrast.
rejected: the overseer of all (loses the wordplay)

choices.why: A reckoning word (false accounting), matched by 'his account' below for ὁ λόγος.

choices.english: the One who has desired us
choices.why: θέλω with a personal object: God has willed or wanted us.
rejected: him who has willed us [so to do] (supplement)

anf_compare.notes: Minor. ANF renders οὐ προσειληφότας τὴν φαινομένην νεωτερικὴν τάξιν as 'not judging rashly from the manifest youthful appearance'; the Greek says the presbyters did not take advantage of his apparently youthful rank. ANF 'seeks to mock' is loose for παραλογίζεται (cheat by false reckoning). Rest same sense.

notes: 'God, who knows the hidden things' may echo Romans 2:16 or Psalm 44:21; not cited inline because the wording is general.

review.notes: Paragraph 1 was checked clause by clause. Pass A tracks the Greek: μὴ συγχρᾶσθαι τῇ ἡλικίᾳ, κατὰ δύναμιν θεοῦ πατρὸς πᾶσαν ἐντροπὴν αὐτῷ ἀπονέμειν, οὐ προσειληφότας τὴν φαινομένην νεωτερικὴν τάξιν, ὡς φρονίμους ἐν θεῷ συγχωροῦντας αὐτῷ, οὐκ αὐτῷ δέ, ἀλλὰ τῷ πατρὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, τῷ πάντων ἐπισκόπῳ, εἰς τιμὴν οὖν ἐκείνου τοῦ θελήσαντος ἡμᾶς πρέπον ἐστὶν ἐπακούειν, οὐχ ὅτι ... πλανᾷ τις, ἀλλὰ τὸν ἀόρατον παραλογίζεται, οὐ πρὸς σάρκα ὁ λόγος. Pass B adds and shifts: 'I know your holy presbyters have done just that' is not in καθὼς ἔγνων καὶ τοὺς ἁγίους πρεσβυτέρους οὐ προσειληφότας; 'as befits the power of God the Father' is not κατὰ δύναμιν; 'he tries to cheat' is not παραλογίζεται; 'a man of flesh' is not πρὸς σάρκα; 'obey without pretense' drops πρέπον ἐστίν. Title names the seen/unseen contrast. No false scripture citation; the note correctly leaves a general echo uncited.
reasons: Pass B adds a claim the Greek does not make: 'I know your holy presbyters have done just that' against 'καθὼς ἔγνων καὶ τοὺς ἁγίους πρεσβυτέρους οὐ προσειληφότας' and Pass A 'just as I know that the holy presbyters too have not taken advantage'.
Pass B 'as befits the power of God the Father' contradicts 'κατὰ δύναμιν θεοῦ πατρὸς πᾶσαν ἐντροπὴν' and Pass A 'according to the power of God the Father'.
Pass B 'he tries to cheat the Bishop he cannot see' adds conative modality against 'ἀλλὰ τὸν ἀόρατον παραλογίζεται' and Pass A 'but he cheats the one who is unseen'.
Pass B 'his account is not with a man of flesh' adds a man and narrows 'οὐ πρὸς σάρκα ὁ λόγος, ἀλλὰ πρὸς θεὸν', which Pass A keeps as 'the reckoning is not with flesh but with God'.
Pass B 'obey without pretense' drops the qualification in 'πρέπον ἐστὶν ἐπακούειν κατὰ μηδεμίαν ὑπόκρισιν', which Pass A keeps as 'it is fitting to obey without any hypocrisy'.
